definition_en: to disturb or annoy someone
core_image: 轻轻敲门、怕惊动别人的人
scene: 他轻轻敲门，不想打扰正在工作的人。He knocked softly so as not to bother anyone.
sceneCN: 这里 bother 是「打扰」（第 1 个义项：给人添麻烦、使人分心）；句意是他轻轻敲门，以免打扰别人。

pos.zh: 名词：麻烦，令人烦恼的事

senses.title: To disturb someone
senses.definition: to interrupt or trouble someone
senses.definitionCN: 打断或给别人添麻烦
senses.example: He knocked softly so as not to bother anyone.
senses.exampleCN: 他轻轻敲门，以免打扰别人。
senses.why: This is the main sense, from a word for confusing or worrying.
senses.whyCN: 这是主要义项，来自表示使人困惑或担忧的词。

senses.title: To make an effort
senses.definition: to take the trouble to do something
senses.definitionCN: 不嫌麻烦地去做某事
senses.example: Don't bother cooking for me.
senses.exampleCN: 不用为我费心做饭了。
senses.why: If an act is a trouble, then bothering is making that effort.
senses.whyCN: 如果一件事是麻烦，那么 bother 就是付出这份心力。

senses.title: A small trouble
senses.definition: a small problem or an annoying effort
senses.definitionCN: 小问题或令人烦恼的麻烦
senses.example: The delay was a bit of a bother.
senses.exampleCN: 这次延误有点麻烦。
senses.why: The verb became a noun for the trouble itself.
senses.whyCN: 动词转化为名词，指麻烦本身。

definition_en: to hit a surface and spring back up

scene: 球从墙上弹了回来。The ball bounced off the wall.
sceneCN: 这里 bounce 是「弹跳」（第 1 个义项：撞到表面后反弹回来）；句意是球从墙上弹了回来。

senses.title: To spring back from a surface
senses.definition: to hit something and move away from it quickly
senses.definitionCN: 撞到某物后迅速离开
senses.example: The ball bounced off the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 球从墙上弹了回来。
senses.why: This is the core sense, from an old word for a heavy blow.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心义项，来自古时表示重击的词。

senses.title: To move up and down

senses.example: The children bounced on the bed.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在床上蹦来蹦去。
senses.why: Anything springing on a soft surface repeats the same movement.
senses.whyCN: 柔软表面上的弹起会不断重复同一个动作。

senses.title: To be sent back unpaid
senses.definition: to be returned by a bank because there is no money
senses.definitionCN: 因账户无钱被银行退回
senses.example: His cheque bounced at the bank.
senses.exampleCN: 他的支票被银行退回了。

senses.whyCN: 支票弹回付款人手里，就说它 bounce 了。
